title: Aegis-UAV-5G: Reproducible Agentic AI Testbed for Detection, Attribution and Containment of Cyberattacks in 5G-Enabled UAV Networks
description: A modular, fully reproducible research testbed that generates the complete experimental evidence base (detection/attribution/containment metrics, tables, figures, statistical tests and per-incident explanation objects) for the study of agentic AI for autonomous cyber-defence of 5G-enabled UAV networks. Level-1 synthetic evaluation with a five-agent pipeline (ADA, TCA, AAA, RSA, PEA) over a shared incident blackboard.

related_identifiers.identifier: Agentic Artificial Intelligence for Autonomous Detection, Attribution, and Containment of Cyberattacks in 5G-Enabled UAV Networks
